dimensions.question: Can a first-time reader explain Eval Lab after twenty seconds?
Does the preview describe a concrete evaluation problem and mechanism?
Can each current claim be traced to project evidence?
Can a reader skim headings, emphasis, and first sentences?
Do the assets show the human/AI relationship without noise or obstruction?
Does the HTML remain understandable on mobile, tablet, and desktop?

decision_rule: Accept the pilot only when claim_safety passes and no weighted dimension is below 3/5; model scores advise, human review decides.
